cosy-lesson.title: Living with Family vs Living Alone (A2)

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Alone ≠ together – without other people around.

p.em: Example: She lives alone in a small apartment.

cosy-blockquote.p: Family ≠ stranger – a group of people related to each other.

p.em: Example: My family eats dinner together every evening.

cosy-blockquote.p: Rent ≠ mortgage – money paid regularly for the use of a room or house.

p.em: Example: Paying monthly rent is expensive in big cities.

cosy-blockquote.p: Quiet ≠ noisy – making very little noise.

p.em: Example: Living alone gives you a quiet room to study.

cosy-blockquote.p: Share ≠ hide – to use or enjoy something with others.

p.em: Example: Brothers and sisters often share a bedroom.

cosy-blockquote.p: Clean ≠ dirty – free from dirt or mess.

p.em: Example: We clean the kitchen every Saturday morning.

cosy-blockquote.p: Cook ≠ order – to prepare food by heating it.

p.em: Example: Cooking at home is cheaper than buying restaurant meals.

cosy-blockquote.p: Help ≠ hinder – to make it easier for someone to do something.

p.em: Example: Family members help each other with house work.

cosy-blockquote.p: Free ≠ busy – having time to relax or do what you want.

p.em: Example: I have free time on Sunday afternoons.

cosy-blockquote.p: Space ≠ crowd – an empty area available for use.

p.em: Example: Having your own space feels comfortable.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
Do you prefer living alone or living with your family?
★ What is the best part about having your own place?

How do you split monthly house rent and utility bills with flatmates?
★ Is housing expensive in your city?

Why do some young adults want a quiet room after a long workday?
★ How do you deal with loud neighbors?

What daily household chores do you share with your family members?
★ Who does the grocery shopping in your home?

Is it easier to keep your bedroom clean when living on your own?
★ How often do you tidy up your living room?

Do you like to cook meals at home or order takeaway food?
★ What simple dish do you cook most often?

How do family members help each other during stressful weeks?
★ Who do you ask for advice when making big decisions?

How do you spend your free time when you have the house to yourself?
★ Do you enjoy solo weekend mornings?

Do you need personal space to relax after work?
★ How much personal space makes you feel comfortable?

How does living with family help young people save money for their future?
★ At what age do people usually leave home in your country?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: collaborative task or visual analysis in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, work together on the following task:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: 1-on-1 guided visual description and task response with teacher.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Look at the prompt and discuss your response with your teacher:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
Living alone helps a young person become independent faster. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you like to live alone for a year?

Sharing a home with family is much better than renting an apartment with strangers. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Have you ever lived with flatmates?

Monthly rent prices in big cities are becoming far too high for young workers. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Is finding affordable housing difficult near you?

Living in a quiet home environment improves daily mental health. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you need silence when working or studying?

Family members should always share household chores equally. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How were household tasks divided in your childhood home?

Learning to clean and manage a home is a necessary life skill for everyone. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Did your parents teach you household management skills?

Learning how to cook healthy meals saves money and improves health. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Should cooking classes be mandatory in schools?

Asking family for financial help is better than taking a bank loan. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Are you comfortable borrowing money from relatives?

Having your own free time without interruption is essential for happiness. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How many hours of alone time do you need each week?

Every adult needs personal space that nobody else can enter without asking. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you have a private corner or study room at home?

ul.li: Incorrect: Living alone is more cheap. → Correct: Living alone is cheaper. ((Short adjective comparative uses '-er': cheaper.))
Incorrect: I live with my family since two years. → Correct: I have lived with my family for two years. ((Use present perfect + 'for' to show duration up to now.))
